tldr: Moon in the 10th house: emotional needs and comfort center on career, status, and public role
body: Moon in the 10th house: emotional needs and comfort center on career, status, and public role. Gift: deep feeling there. Watch: moods ride on it. With the Moon in the 10th house, emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety move through career, public role, reputation, authority, and legacy. This makes how you become visible, take responsibility, and build a life that can be recognized a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs. Left unconscious, it can become mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs expressed through public contribution.
challenge: mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area concentrated in public contribution.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
